title: 🐱 Playful & Sweet Cats Ready for Adoption in Newport, KY - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago Looking to add a furry friend to your family? These adorable cats in Newport, Kentucky are waiting for loving homes through the Stray Animal Adoption Program (SAAP) . Each one has their own charm and story — maybe one will be your perfect match!
Bambina Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: About 10–12 months
Gender: Female
Color: Gray/Blue
Adoption Fee: $100
Shelter: Stray Animal Adoption Program
Phone: (859) 391-1234
Bambina’s name means “young one” in Italian — and she truly is! After raising four kittens, this sweet girl is ready for a home of her own. She loves gentle pets and attention. She was recently spayed and is still getting used to meeting other cats, but with slow introductions, she should do well.
👉 Meet Bambina and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Onion Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Kitten
Gender: Male
Color: Orange/Red
Adoption Fee: $100
Shelter: Stray Animal Adoption Program
Phone: (859) 391-1234
Meet Onion — a confident, easygoing kitten with stunning marbled markings. He’s playful, curious, and surprisingly comfortable around dogs, even big ones! Onion fits right in wherever he goes and will make a wonderful companion for a family with other pets.
👉 Meet Onion and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Olivia John Newton Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Kitten
Gender: Female
Color: Orange/Red
Adoption Fee: $100
Shelter: Stray Animal Adoption Program
Phone: (859) 391-1234
This little orange sweetheart is ready to charm her way into your heart. Olivia John Newton is young, curious, and full of kitten energy — perfect for a home that loves to play and cuddle.
👉 Meet Olivia John Newton and apply to adopt on adoptapet
Karen Carpenter Breed: Domestic Shorthair
Age: Kitten
Gender: Female
Color: Black
Adoption Fee: $100
Shelter: Stray Animal Adoption Program
Phone: (859) 391-1234
Karen Carpenter is a sleek black kitten with a gentle spirit. She’s young, curious, and ready to grow up in a loving home that will give her plenty of affection and playtime.
👉 Meet Karen Carpenter and apply to adopt on adoptapet
